products.name: Cough syrup for dry cough
products.summary: Benylin Dry Cough syrup, for irritating dry coughs.
products.description:
Benylin Dry Cough is a syrup for irritating dry coughs. The pack names dextromethorphan as the active ingredient.

Dose, bottle size and age limits are printed on the pack and are not repeated here. This product is supplied after a pharmacist has checked it is suitable, particularly if it is for a child.

products.name: Paracetamol 500mg tablets
products.summary: M&B Paracetamol 500mg tablets: 8 strips of 12.
products.description:
M&B Paracetamol 500mg B.P. tablets, 8 strips of 12 tablets (96 tablets). The box says the tablets are effective on pains, aches and fever and gentle on the stomach.

The pack carries the “80 years heritage of quality” mark.
products.howToUse: Adults: 1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed; do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours. Swallow whole with water. A health professional should set the dose for children. (Retailer listing: check against the pack leaflet before publishing.)
products.warnings: Do not exceed the stated dose. Possible side effects include nausea and stomach upset; rarely allergic reactions, severe skin reactions or liver damage with prolonged use. Avoid alcohol. (Retailer listing: check against the pack leaflet.)
products.storage: Keep in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and out of reach of children. (Retailer listing.)
products.imageAlt: M&B Paracetamol 500mg: red carton beside a silver blister strip of white tablets
products.imageSource: Supplied by Reset Pharmacy’s agency (Dindu Digitals) on 24 Oct 2026 as a product photograph. Original publisher not recorded; permission to reuse not confirmed. Studio backdrop whitened.

products.name: Antacid chewable tablets, mint
products.summary: Rolaids Original mint chewable antacid tablets, 96.
products.description: Rolaids Original chewable antacid tablets, mint flavour, bottle of 96. They are used for heartburn, acid indigestion and sour or upset stomach.
products.activeIngredients: Calcium carbonate 675mg and magnesium hydroxide 135mg per tablet
products.howToUse: Adults and children 12 years and over: chew 2 to 4 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor.
products.warnings: Do not take more than 10 tablets in 24 hours. Do not use the maximum dose for more than 2 weeks except under a doctor’s advice and supervision. Ask a doctor before use if you have kidney disease or a magnesium-restricted diet. Ask a doctor or pharmacist if you take a prescription medicine, as antacids can interact with some. If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
products.imageAlt: Rolaids Original mint chewable tablets: blue and white bottle labelled 96 chewable tablets

products.name: Antihistamine allergy tablets
products.summary: Zyrtec Allergy cetirizine 10mg tablets, 30. Supplied after a pharmacist check.
products.description:
Zyrtec Allergy 10mg cetirizine hydrochloride antihistamine tablets, 30 per pack. The pack describes 24-hour relief of sneezing, runny nose, itchy and watery eyes and an itchy throat or nose from indoor and outdoor allergies.

This product is supplied after a pharmacist has checked it is suitable for you.
products.howToUse: Adults and children 6 years and over: one 10mg tablet once daily; do not take more than one 10mg tablet in 24 hours. Adults 65 and over, children under 6, and people with liver or kidney disease should ask a doctor first. (US label text: confirm against the stocked pack.)
products.warnings: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to cetirizine or any of the ingredients, or to an antihistamine containing hydroxyzine. Ask a doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. Ask a doctor or pharmacist if you take tranquillisers or sedatives. Drowsiness may occur; avoid alcohol; take care driving or using machinery. Stop use and get medical help if an allergic reaction occurs. Pregnant: ask a health professional. Breast-feeding: not recommended.
products.storage: Store at 20–25°C. Do not use if the pouch is torn or damaged.

products.summary: Flo Baby saline nasal drops, 15ml. Preservative free.
products.description: Flo Baby saline nasal drops, 15ml. The pack says the drops are preservative free, non-medicated and isotonic, to clear a congested nose in newborn babies and toddlers quickly and gently.

products.description: Burnaid burn gel in a 25g tube, from Mundicare. The pack describes it as a hydrogel for minor burns, scalds and sunburn that cools and soothes, helps relieve pain and has an antiseptic formula.
